NONE: › not given a value in a ranking or rating system, especially the rating system for films, that says which ones children can watch
（尤指在電影分級制度中）未分級的

example: an unrated coming-of-age tale
一部未分級的青春成長的故事

I or T: › [ I or T ] If a piece of knitted or woven cloth, a knot, or a mass of thread unravels, it separates into a single thread, and if you unravel it, you separate it into a single thread.
› [ I or T ] If you unravel a mysterious, unknown, or complicated subject, you make it known or understood, and if it unravels, it becomes known or understood.
揭開，弄清，闡明（謎團或複雜問題）；被澄清；被解決

I, T usually passive: › [ I,  T usually passive ] If a process or achievement that was slow and complicated unravels or is unravelled, it is destroyed.

example: You'd better mend that hole before the whole sweater starts to unravel.
你最好把那個洞補上，免得整件毛衣脫線。
I had to unravel one of the sleeves because I realized I'd knitted it too small.
我不得不拆掉一隻袖子，因爲我發現它織得太小了。
We have a long way to go before we unravel the secrets of genetics.
在揭開遺傳學之謎前，我們還有很長的路要走。
As talks between the leaders broke down, several months of careful diplomacy were unravelled.
由於領導人之間的會談破裂，幾個月精心策劃的外交努力付諸東流。

NONE: › too boring, complicated, or badly written to be worth reading
（因內容枯燥、晦澀或文筆拙劣）難以閱讀的，不適合讀的，不值得一讀的
› illegible (= impossible to read because not clear or untidy)
字跡模糊的；無法辨識的

example: I found James Joyce's "Ulysses" to be totally unreadable.
我發現詹姆斯•喬伊斯的《尤利西斯》不好讀。
completely unreadable handwriting
完全無從辨認的筆跡

NONE: › as if imagined; strange and dream-like
不真實的；虛幻的；夢境般的；奇異的
C1 slang extremely or surprisingly good
極好的，好得令人喜出望外的

example: The whole bizarre evening had an unreal quality to it.
這個古怪的夜晚讓人感覺很不真實。
We saw so many shooting stars that night, it was unreal!
我們看到了那麼多流星，實在令人喜出望外。

NONE: B2 having a wrong idea of what is likely to happen or of what you can really do; not based on facts
不切實際的；不實事求是的；不現實的

example: I think these sales forecasts are unrealistic, considering how slow sales are at present.
考慮到目前的銷售速度有多慢，我覺得這些銷售預測是不切實際的。
[ + to infinitive ] It's unrealistic to expect an answer before next week.
期待下週之前得到答覆是不切實際的。

NONE: B2 not fair or acceptable
不講道理的；不合理的；不公正的

example: [ + to infinitive ] It seems unreasonable to expect one person to do both jobs.
要一個人做兩份工作似乎是不合理的。

NONE: › Unreasoning feelings or beliefs are not based on reason or judgment.
（情感或信仰）缺乏理性的；無緣無故的
› having opinions or behaving in a way not considered to be modern or politically acceptable in modern times
（觀點或行爲方式）頑固守舊的，食古不化的

example: She describes herself as an unreconstructed feminist.
她說她自己是個頑固守舊的女權主義者。

NONE: › not written about before, and therefore not known about
未留下記錄的
› (of sounds or moving pictures) not recorded on electronic equipment
（聲音或影像）未錄製下來的

example: The singer told fans he had a new unrecorded song to try out on them.
歌手告訴他的歌迷，他有一首尚未錄製的新歌向他們試唱。

NONE: › in a natural state, without having been through a chemical or industrial process to remove unwanted parts; not refined
未精製的；未提煉的；不優雅的，粗俗的
› An unregulated type of business or activity is not controlled and directed by fixed rules or laws.
（企業或活動）未加監管的，缺乏規範的
C1 having no connection
無關聯的，不相關的

example: Police said his death was unrelated to the attack.
警方說他的死和那次襲擊無關。

NONE: › extremely determined; never becoming weaker or admitting defeat
堅定不移的；不鬆懈的；不屈不撓的

example: She will be remembered as an unrelenting opponent of racial discrimination.
她不屈不撓地反對種族歧視，將會為人所銘記。

NONE: B2 not able to be trusted or believed
不可靠的；不能信賴的

example: The bus service is unreliable.
公車服務不可靠。
Opposite
reliable

NONE: › When a bad situation or emotion is unrelieved, it is continuous and never improves, not even for a short period.
（糟糕的形勢或情緒）未改善的，未緩和的

example: She held the family together through years of unrelieved poverty.
她帶領全家人一起度過了貧困的漫長歲月。

NONE: › ordinary and not interesting
一般的，平常的，普通的

example: an unremarkable town
一個普通的城鎮

NONE: › never stopping, becoming weaker, or failing
不停的；不懈的；持續不斷的

example: Our thanks are due to Bob Lawrence whose unremitting labours have ensured the success of the whole project.
我們要感謝鮑勃‧勞倫斯，是他不懈的努力確保了整個計劃的成功。

usually before noun: › [ usually before noun ] An unrepeatable event, price, etc. cannot happen again.
（事件、價格等）不可重復的，不會再有的

NONE: › An unrepeatable word or remark used by another person is too rude or too difficult for you to repeat.
（字眼或言語過於粗魯或艱深而）不宜重提的，說不出口的

example: an unrepeatable offer/opportunity
不會再有的出價／機會
an unrepeatable experience
不可重複的經歷
an unrepeatable joke/name
不堪重複的玩笑／說不出口的名字

NONE: › not repentant (= feeling sorry for something that you have done)
不思悔改的；頑固不化的
› not typical of a larger group of people or things; not representative
無代表性的，不典型的
› If love that you feel for someone is unrequited, it is not felt in the same way by the other person.
（愛情）單方面的，得不到回報的，單相思的

example: It's just another poem on the pain of unrequited love.
這不過又是一首表現單思之苦的詩。

NONE: › formal without any doubts or feeling uncertain; total
無保留的；毫無疑問的；絕對的；全部的，徹底的
› An unreserved seat, ticket, etc. is not being kept for a particular person to use.
（座位、門票等）未預留的

example: Critics expressed unreserved enthusiasm for the book.
書評人對此書表達了毫無保留的熱忱。
I searched the pub for an unreserved table.
我在酒吧裡尋找沒有預留的座位。

NONE: › If a problem or difficulty is unresolved, it is not solved or ended.
（問題或困難）未解決的，未克服的

example: The question of contracts remains unresolved.
合同問題依然沒有得到解決。

NONE: › not reacting in a quick or positive way to something
無反應的；無應答的
› not reacting or moving at all because of being unconscious or very ill
（因失去知覺或患重病而）沒有反應的，完全不動的

example: Depression can make a new mother unresponsive to her baby.
憂鬱症可能會導致母親對剛生下來不久的孩子沒有反應。
The patient was collapsed and unresponsive when he was brought into hospital.
病人被送到醫院時處於昏迷狀態，沒有反應。

NONE: C2 disagreements or fighting between different groups of people
動亂，動盪；騷亂

example: It is feared that the civil unrest we are now witnessing in this country could lead to full-scale civil war.
我們害怕現在國內出現的騷亂會升級爲全面內戰。

NONE: › not limited or controlled
不受限制（或控制）的；無節制的
› not limited or controlled by rules or laws
不受規則（或法律）限制的

example: The company allowed the reporters unrestricted access to data from around the time of the accident.
這家公司讓記者可無限接觸事故發生時間前後的數據。
Opposite
restricted

NONE: › (of food or crops) not yet ready to be eaten or collected; not yet ripe
（食物或農作物）還不能吃的，未收穫的，未成熟的

example: Here are some ideas for what you can do with unripe green tomatoes.
這裡有一些如何利用未成熟番茄的方法。

NONE: › having no equal; better than any other of the same type
沒有對手的；無可匹敵的；無與倫比的

example: The museum boasts an unrivalled collection of French porcelain.
該博物館擁有舉世無雙的法國瓷器藏品。

NONE: › to open and become flat from a rolled position, or to cause something to do this
（使）鋪開；（使）展開

example: She unrolled the most beautiful carpet.
她展開了這塊精美絕倫的地毯。

NONE: › calm; not nervous or worried, usually despite a difficult situation
平靜的；泰然自若的

example: For a man in danger of losing his job, he appeared fairly unruffled.
對於一個可能會丟掉工作的人來說，他表現得相當鎮定自若。

NONE: › Unruly people are difficult to control and often do not obey rules.
（人）難以控制的，難駕馭的，難管束的
› Unruly hair is difficult to keep tidyneat, often sticking up or out.
（頭髮）難梳理的，蓬亂的

example: an unruly class of adolescents
難以管理的少年班別
an unruly mop of black hair
一頭又難梳理又亂蓬蓬的黑髮
